title: Tighten memory recovery previews and docs after the compact listing landed
outcome: Tighten memory recovery previews and docs after the compact listing landed
acceptance: A compact recovery preview does not end at an abbreviation such as "e.g.", "i.e.", "etc." or "vs." anywhere in the first line.

A test shows a graph snapshot load clearing every session's recorded memory position, and the docs and code comments name graph restore and projection repair, not replay, as the rebuilds that clear it.
docs/shipped.md says the compact recovery listing applies only to an unfiltered listing that carries the generation, and describes its pages as up to 64 rows fitted to the response budget.
